verdict.rationale: Natural-language operation is a fair question for accounting SaaS, but the evidence pack documents no conversational assistant, chat interface, or natural-language command feature in FreshBooks. The REST API, OAuth, webhooks, and Node SDK are developer building blocks a third party could use to build such an interface. They are not the capability itself, so they earn no credit. Bill Pay's document capture is an adjacent automation, not natural-language command handling.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
